SELECT FROM historical_places p LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = p.region_id
AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.period LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.heritage_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.sido_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.gugun_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM place_tags pt JOIN history_tags ht ON ht.tag_id = pt.tag_id WHERE pt.place_id = p.place_id AND ht.tag_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )
AND r.sido_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sidoName}, '%')
AND r.gugun_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{gugunName}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM place_tags pt JOIN history_tags ht ON ht.tag_id = pt.tag_id WHERE pt.place_id = p.place_id AND ht.tag_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tagName}, '%') )
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN p.title = #{keyword} THEN 1 WHEN p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 WHEN r.sido_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.gugun_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 3 WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM place_tags pt JOIN history_tags ht ON ht.tag_id = pt.tag_id WHERE pt.place_id = p.place_id AND ht.tag_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) THEN 4 WHEN p.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 5 WHEN p.period LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 6 WHEN p.heritage_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 7 ELSE 8 END,
p.view_count DESC, p.place_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT p.place_id, r.region_id, r.sido_name, r.gugun_name FROM historical_places p LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = p.region_id WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId}
